structure_plan.overview: Small freestanding wall section, footprint 3x2 studs, height 3 bricks, with a tiled cap and one accent-colored brick.

subassemblies.name: Wall stack
subassemblies.description: 3 brick-high stack using 2x2 + 1x2 bricks per layer, alternating seam for a simple bond pattern.

step_outline.title: Base plate
step_outline.description: Place 1x Plate 2x3 (3021) Light Bluish Gray on the ground (studs up).

step_outline.title: Layer 1 (height 1 brick)
step_outline.description: On the base, build a 3x2 layer: place 1x Brick 2x2 (3003) Light Bluish Gray on the left, and 1x Brick 1x2 (3004) Light Bluish Gray on the right (both aligned, forming a 3-stud-wide row).

step_outline.title: Layer 2 (height 2 bricks)
step_outline.description: Alternate the seam: place 1x Brick 1x2 (3004) Red on the left, and 1x Brick 2x2 (3003) Light Bluish Gray on the right.

step_outline.title: Layer 3 (height 3 bricks)
step_outline.description: Repeat Layer 1: place 1x Brick 2x2 (3003) Light Bluish Gray on the left, and 1x Brick 1x2 (3004) Light Bluish Gray on the right.

step_outline.title: Tiled top cap
step_outline.description: Cover the top studs: place 1x Tile 2x2 (3068b) Light Bluish Gray over the 2x2 area, and 1x Tile 1x2 (3069b) Light Bluish Gray over the remaining 1x2 area.

notes: Inventory check (suggested colors): 3021 LBG x1; 3003 LBG x3; 3004 LBG x2; 3004 Red x1; 3068b LBG x1; 3069b LBG x1.
If any tile type is unavailable in target library, substitute the cap with plates: 1x Plate 2x2 (3022) + 1x Plate 1x2 (3023) in Light Bluish Gray.
